root_cause.text: `filesystems_freeze_callback()` in `fs/super.c` used the `freeze_all_ptr` condition with the wrong polarity, so the callback froze all filesystems when it should have skipped them unless `FS_POWER_FREEZE` was set, leading to improper freeze attempts and `WARN_ON_ONCE()` in `__set_task_frozen()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (freeze_all_ptr && !(sb->s_type->fs_flags & FS_POWER_FREEZE)) return;` to `if (!freeze_all_ptr && !(sb->s_type->fs_flags & FS_POWER_FREEZE)) return;`, and the CVE text says this reverse check “causes all file systems to be frozen when filesystem_freeze_enabled is false,” triggering `WARN_ON_ONCE()` in `__set_task_frozen()`.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: `filesystems_freeze_callback()` in `fs/super.c` used the `freeze_all_ptr` condition with the wrong polarity, so the callback froze all filesystems when it should have skipped them unless `FS_POWER_FREEZE` was set, leading to improper freeze attempts and `WARN_ON_ONCE()` in `__set_task_frozen()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the freeze callback so non-`FS_POWER_FREEZE` filesystems are included in freeze-all handling rather than incorrectly skipped.
intent_record.what: In `filesystems_freeze_callback()`, the condition guarding the early return was changed from `if (freeze_all_ptr && !(sb->s_type->fs_flags & FS_POWER_FREEZE))` to `if (!freeze_all_ptr && !(sb->s_type->fs_flags & FS_POWER_FREEZE))`.
intent_record.how: This reverses when non-`FS_POWER_FREEZE` filesystems are skipped: previously they were excluded during the 'freeze all' path, and now they are excluded only when not freezing all. As a result, filesystems without the `FS_POWER_FREEZE` flag will now participate in the freeze-all operation instead of being bypassed, changing which superblocks get frozen during that flow.

grouping_result.intent: Fix the freeze callback so non-`FS_POWER_FREEZE` filesystems are included in freeze-all handling rather than incorrectly skipped.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly matches the root cause: it fixes the polarity of the freeze callback condition in `filesystems_freeze_callback()` so filesystems are handled correctly during freeze-all, addressing the improper freeze attempts and resulting warning.

candidates.rationale: This condition has the wrong polarity for freeze-all handling: it returns early for filesystems that do not have FS_POWER_FREEZE, which prevents them from being frozen when they should be included, matching the root cause.

vuln_statements.explanation: This condition uses the wrong polarity for freeze-all handling: it treats filesystems without FS_POWER_FREEZE as the ones to be skipped, which causes incorrect freeze behavior and leads to improper freeze attempts and WARN_ON_ONCE() in __set_task_frozen().
